scripts.generate-config: node -e "const supabaseUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || process.env.SUPABASE_URL || ''; const supabaseAnonKey = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || process.env.SUPABASE_ANON_KEY || ''; const siteUrl = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL || process.env.SITE_URL || ''; const cfg = { supabase: { url: supabaseUrl, anonKey: supabaseAnonKey }, adminEmail: process.env.ADMIN_EMAIL || '', storageBucket: process.env.STORAGE_BUCKET || 'portfolio-assets', turnstileSiteKey: process.env.TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY || '', siteUrl }; console.log('window.EA_RUNTIME_CONFIG = ' + JSON.stringify(cfg, null, 2) + ';');" > portfolio/assets/js/runtime-config.js
scripts.minify:css: npx clean-css-cli -o portfolio/assets/css/style.css portfolio/assets/css/style.css && npx clean-css-cli -o portfolio/assets/css/admin.css portfolio/assets/css/admin.css
scripts.minify:js: npx terser portfolio/assets/js/main.js -o portfolio/assets/js/main.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/content-service.js -o portfolio/assets/js/content-service.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/contact.js -o portfolio/assets/js/contact.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/security.js -o portfolio/assets/js/security.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/seo.js -o portfolio/assets/js/seo.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/default-data.js -o portfolio/assets/js/default-data.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/supabase-config.js -o portfolio/assets/js/supabase-config.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/theme.js -o portfolio/assets/js/theme.js -c -m && npx terser portfolio/assets/js/admin.js -o portfolio/assets/js/admin.js -c -m
scripts.build: npm run minify:css && npm run minify:js
